definitions.explanation: A video produced to promote a song, typically featuring the artist performing or a storyline. Commonly used in Japanese music industry.

examples.japanese: {新曲|しんきょく}のPVが{公開|こうかい}された。
examples.english: The music video for the new song was released.

examples.japanese: このPVは{再生|さいせい}{回数|かいすう}が1{億|おく}{回|かい}を{超|こ}えた。
examples.english: This music video has exceeded 100 million views.

examples.japanese: PVの{撮影|さつえい}で{海外|かいがい}ロケに{行|い}った。
examples.english: They went on location abroad for the music video shoot.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of English 'Promotional Video'. While MV (music video) is also used, PV remains common in Japan.

USAGE:
Standard term in Japanese music industry for music videos. Often used interchangeably with MV, though PV emphasizes the promotional aspect.

COLLOCATIONS:
・PVを{撮|と}る - to shoot a music video
・PVを{公開|こうかい}する - to release a music video
・PV{撮影|さつえい} - music video filming
